title: sphaeralcea coccinea
intro: Sphaeralcea coccinea, commonly known as the Red Globe Mallow, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mallow family (Malvaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Sphaeralcea coccinea include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
